title: VUA environment.verifyEditor (v0.1)
description: Query face for verifying one user-picked Unity editor path (proposal 021 vocabulary row, core ruling 2026-09-13 seven points). FROZEN v0.1 (freeze batch 2026-09-13, environment role): the freeze sequence is closed — (1) the detection-domain primitive editor_verify v0.1 landed (3eef4e4); (2) the seven-point core ruling (proposal 021 inline thread) fixed this row's shape; (3) this draft face + positive/negative vectors + the environment-side anchor consumer tests landed and were accepted into main (71c65d4); (4) the core routing batch landed and was accepted into main (provider-host route + the EDITOR_VERIFY_SCHEMA_VERSION const + the three nails + frame-loop consumer tests; merge a6585c2, capabilities row available); (5) the bilingual protocol document (docs/protocols/editor-verify-v0.1) and the docs/REGISTRY.md row land with this freeze batch, and the scripts/collab-brief.mjs SCHEMA_EXEMPT 'editor-verify' row is requested removed at acceptance (the integration role removes it; dffb1e3 precedent). Line name environment.verifyEditor (ruling point 1: consumer semantics, same detection-domain fact family as environment.getSnapshot; the directory/family name editor-verify anchors the primitive and the refusal-code family vua.editor_verify.* — the mapping is stated in the protocol document's first section). Application kind: query (ruling point 2) — a parameterized read-only verification with zero state change, zero tasking, synchronous request/response (project.inspectProject precedent; the snapshot is never mutated by this call). Params are a closed single-key set {path} (ruling point 3): the user-picked path travels verbatim in all three accepted layouts (the executable itself, the versioned Hub root, or the Editor directory); no maxLength is set on purpose — a user-supplied filesystem path is verbatim carry and the write side invents no exclusive bound (c914cf2 discipline). The result is a two-state tagged union discriminated by verdict (ruling point 4), with the three implementation nails: (1) a refusal NEVER surfaces as an application error envelope — refused is a normal result state, because a refusal is a finding, not a failure; (2) detail carries the primitive's raw resource text verbatim and is never re-interpreted downstream; (3) the envelope schemaVersion is the const "0.1". classification and guidanceCode are byte-identical to the frozen environment-managers v0.1 editorClass enum and guidance pattern (zero-invention diff-check points, verified at the freeze batch). Routing-not-wired semantics (ruling point 5): the honest absence code vua.environment.verify_unavailable is reserved for the unwired route / unreachable primitive only and is never reused as a verification refusal. Primitive of record: crates/project-manager/src/editor_verify.rs verify_editor_path (3eef4e4); the wire serialization face itself is carried by the core routing batch (provider-host).

path.description: User-picked path, carried verbatim (no normalization on the wire; normalization is the primitive's job). Closed single-key params: minLength 1, and deliberately no maxLength.

editorClass.description: Core classification closed set (EditorClass, serde snake_case), byte-identical to the frozen environment-managers v0.1 editorClass enum.

guidanceCode.description: Compatibility-policy guidance code from the core classifier; render it, never promote an off-target verdict.

refusalCode.description: Closed five-code refusal set from the primitive's codes module (vua.editor_verify.* family). A refusal is a normal finding, never an application error.

environment-verifyEditorResult.description: Two-state tagged union discriminated by verdict. verified: identity established by reading the executable's own version resource (gate 1: never the directory name), classified per the support matrix (gate 2). refused: a normal in-result finding with a closed code — never an application error envelope (nail 1).

editorRoot.description: Hub-layout versioned root when the picked path follows that layout, otherwise the executable's immediate directory. Informational only — identity comes from the version string, never this name.

exePath.description: The executable the identity read targeted.

version.description: Complete version string as parsed (display form).

chinaDistribution.description: Unity China distribution build (c<n> suffix); receives unsupported-environment diagnosis, never silently used as the production editor.

exePath.description: The executable the read targeted, when one was located.

detail.description: Human-readable diagnosis from the primitive; raw resource strings are quoted verbatim, never interpreted (nail 2: carried unchanged by the wire and desktop layers).
